user_instruction: Ask before moving to each next step.

steps.name: Collect authentic source data
steps.scope: India 2010-2025; nine original source files and documented verification

steps.name: Clean data and build SQL database
steps.scope: DuckDB, reproducible cleaning pipeline, provenance, 8 passing tests and 14 build checks

steps.name: Calculate supplier shares and historical changes
steps.scope: 29 periods, 18 comparisons, 12 metric checks, 18 total passing tests, charts and executed analysis notebook

steps.name: Build website and 3D equipment viewer
steps.scope: Local website, 149 searchable records, four illustrative 3D models, supplier analysis, source references; desktop smoke review and four web tests passed; mobile device QA pending

steps.name: ML for unusual supplier changes
steps.prerequisite: Three-recipient annual coverage validated; broader global coverage still required for generalization
steps.scope: Isolation Forest; 293 training and 152 review transitions; 7 review flags; temporal split, baseline and seed-stability checks; 9 ML/web tests passed

steps.name: ML for similar supplier profiles
steps.scope: 80 eligible profiles from 4,761 official SIPRI global annual delivery rows, 2021-2025; Hellinger nearest-neighbor retrieval; leave-year-out and cosine sensitivity; 14 focused tests passed

steps.name: Integrate and test
steps.scope: 32 automated tests and 236 API responses passed; six routes checked at 390x844 browser viewport; desktop map checked; physical-device and production deployment testing remain outside this stage.

steps.name: Deploy and prepare portfolio demo
steps.scope: Public Render Free deployment verified with health endpoint, supplier map, equipment details, 3D explorer, ML insights and similarity profiles. Portfolio walkthrough documented. Free-tier cold starts apply.
